@**Max** , I created a solver for LLM hosting economics:
https://github.com/Monadical-SAS/llm-hosting-economics

Here are the calculations for the models we measured today:

[image.png](/user_uploads/4/d7/kUYkgLhqAC-QY-lRdIAw8E1_/image.png)

Inputs / assumptions:
- 70% average utilization (on the optimistic side)
- Cost: Datacrunch spot instance with B200
- Input, Output prices taken from bf16 on Openrouter
- 0% Openrouter cut (from what I read, they charge 5% on deposits and that's it)
- Average input to output token ratio taken from a typical day stats on Openrouter for GLM 4.6 (see https://openrouter.ai/z-ai/glm-4.6:exacto/activity)

Personally I'm surprised how high the revenue numbers are, perhaps the practical utilization that providers see is low - I thought this would be a super competitive space. Or maybe the typical usage is at much higher input lenghts than tested, we could find some stats on that and benchmark accordingly.

Feel free to play around with the numbers in Marimo - it solves a system of constraints, so it can calculate all the missing ones from others, of course if solvable.

cc @**Daniil Kulko**
